split_policy: Visible development and heldout partitions are separated by scenario-family ID, task domain and lexical anchors. Heldout is not secret. Once it informs a change, retire the affected family from heldout and add a new family before making a generalisation claim.

measurement_policy.execution: One real MIST session per case; submit each user event at its frozen time and feed actual assistant history forward. Do not insert expected assistant turns.
measurement_policy.timing_clock: All scenario offsets are monotonic milliseconds from case start. Capture user acoustic end, final ASR availability, assistant committed turn, first text, first useful phrase, first audible sample, playback stop, tool call/result and task revision on the same monotonic clock when possible. Keep clock source and synchronization uncertainty in the run record.
measurement_policy.useful_response: A useful response advances the stated user goal, answers, asks a necessary clarification, acknowledges a meaningful correction, or reports a verified current result. Filler and unrelated acknowledgements do not count.
measurement_policy.objective_vs_semantic: Structural event assertions and exact fixture facts may be deterministic. Meaning, whether clarification is warranted, whether intent was respected, and voice/tone fit require transcript/event review or blind human review. Never treat a text transcript as evidence of acoustic quality.
measurement_policy.unavailable_evidence: If the adapter cannot schedule timed segments, inspect playback, inject a background completion, expose task revisions or preserve the required memory fixture, mark unsupported. Do not count a generic text reply as a pass.
